payload.text: Two rules for 0077 and 0079 (vc, 19 Oct). The candidate lives only in cc's worktree, detached at main's head (scratchpad wt-cc, .githooks/*.intent copied in): never in the primary, which is live for hv's menu and shared with utilz-ic's path commits; the primary takes the patch at each landing. Every START says light or heavy (gtools-vc's light lane): light builds nothing, starts no GUI or daemon, binds no port and writes no state another run reads; any whole suite is heavy.
